name: Kiss of Wolves 2: My Sumptuous Conifers
source:
After the events of [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/other/the-deciduous-forest-kiss-of-wolves/27017/]Kiss of Wolves[/url], Cyrus must take care of his cubs in the Coniferous Forest of Valsar.

Inspired by Disney Bears, Sluggish Morss, and film noir.

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/other/kiss-of-wolves-2-my-sumptuous-conifers/27045/]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
在[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/other/the-deciduous-forest-kiss-of-wolves/27017/]《狼之吻》[/url]事件後，賽勒斯必須在瓦爾薩爾針葉林照顧自己的幼崽。

靈感來自《迪士尼熊》、Sluggish Morss與黑色電影。
